description: Pixel pass that hashes pixel position for jitter, reconstructs motion from auxiliary buffers, gathers many integer scene-color samples, and emits a scene-only post-process target.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Verified live by a neutral replacement and a solid-magenta scene-only coverage test with UI unaffected.

checks.meaning: The pass derives integer fetch positions from the current output pixel.
Scene color and two motion or tile metadata buffers feed the verified permutation.
All inputs are addressed with integer pixel loads rather than filtered sampling.
A dense set of scene-color and motion-buffer loads forms the blur gather.
Candidate sample positions are repeatedly rounded to integer pixel coordinates.
Rounded positions are converted for direct Texture2D loads.
The verified UE4 permutation hashes pixel position with the same two-component jitter seed.
The position hash uses the verified UE4 jitter multiplier.
Gathered scene-color samples are normalized as an eight-tap contribution.
The resolved scene color is written to RGB.
The verified scene-only intermediate emits zero alpha.

postControlSynthesis.controlledChannels: RGB scene color only; preserve the pass's zero-alpha output behavior
postControlSynthesis.adapterRequirement: Confirm output is consumed before UI composition and determine the scene-color transfer function before treating luminance weights as colorimetrically exact.
postControlSynthesis.liveEvidenceRequirement: Confirm scene-only color change with HUD unaffected and instant Original/Current A/B restoration.
postControlSynthesis.perceptualUniformity: not established; 0.5 linear RGB appeared mostly gray in the verified dark scene

adapterMustConfirm: output target is consumed before UI composition
solid-color coverage excludes HUD and menus
neutral replacement parity at native resolution
scene-color transfer function and HDR state
